description: TU Delft and municipal project partners publish two lateral experiments on three-by-four groups of historic timber foundation piles at Overamstel. One test includes axial top load and one omits it. The source describes pile forces, cap deflections, rotations and selected in-ground strain measurements. Both 2022 tests use the same instrumentation. Coverage: 2022 Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: Excel spreadsheets, plain-text files and documentation. Licence: CC0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: The native latitude and longitude labels are reversed relative to the other Overamstel records. Named-site evidence is retained; coordinates are not silently corrected or imported. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
